verdict.rationale: Founder Law's pricing pages bundle everything into one flat fee. The pricing page says 'One flat fee. Everything included.' and the about page says packages cover 'government filing fees, premium processing, and any RFE responses.' That makes the all-in number clear, but nothing shows the firm's legal fee itemized apart from USCIS filing fees and premium processing, which is the separation this story asks for. Bundling is a related but different approach, so it earns no credit here.

support.subject: As a founder, the provider's pricing pages separate its own fees from USCIS filing fees and premium processing, so the all-in cost is honest
